spinnerPack.description: Themed spinner + animated gradient for the working/loading indicator. Mirrors the core `display.spinnerPack` setting that the loader reads.

animations.description: Enable the animated gradient sweep. When off, the pack renders a static gradient. Backed at runtime by the core `display.shimmer` toggle and independent of `display.animations`; `display.animations: off` does not still the sweep today.
